description: The JSON form Routine Run reads a routine in: every field, every action a step can take, and what a routine that works in the app has. With part "examples", three routines written in it and the shortcuts the app adds in one tap. Use it when writing a routine for routine_link, start_new_run or propose_new_routine.

part.description: "form", the fields and actions, if left out; "examples", three routines in the form and the one-tap shortcuts.

name: how_to_write_a_routine
title: How to write a routine
